# Terminal UI: remove the Workspaces tab, New terminal dialog, sessions in the sidebar, close dialog, Settings → Repositories

## What to build

The web UI of graph-manager (`apps/graph-manager/src/web`) moves from "clone on the Workspaces page, then open a terminal in a clone" to **repo sessions**: a user clicks **New terminal**, picks a repository (or a live session), a branch (new by default, or an existing one) and an agent, and gets a terminal. The server side already exists (it was built before this task, see "What already exists"); this task is the UI on top of it, the removal of the Workspaces tab everywhere (route, nav, `g w`, palette, overview poll, the clone and delete routes, README, TESTING.md, ui-smoke.sh), the terminal sidebar grouped by session with the session count, the "uncommitted changes" close dialog (Push to branch / Keep open / Discard), the `save-failed` state with Retry / Discard, and a new **Settings → Repositories** section that holds today's `WorkspaceSettingsDrawer` contents and the saved run defaults. It also adds one small server piece the dialog needs: listing a repository's branches from the forge (`GET /api/repos/branches`).

Do not change anything in `packages/graph-execution` (the engine): the plain CLI must stay exactly as it is.

## What already exists (built by earlier tasks; read the code, do not rebuild it)

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/sessions.ts` (sessions task): `GET /api/sessions` → the signed-in user's sessions with their terminal ids; `GET /api/repos?q=` → repositories of the user's connected forges; `POST /api/sessions` with `{ repo } | { projectId }` plus `{ branch: { new?: string } | { existing: string }, agent?: string, cols?, rows? }` → `201 { sessionId, terminalId, branch }` (a repository that already has a live session gets a new terminal in it; the branch is ignored); above `GM_MAX_SESSIONS` it answers `409 {"error":"You have 3 open repositories. Close all terminals of one to open another."}` (the number is the limit); `POST /api/sessions/:id/terminals` `{ agent? }` → a new terminal in a live session; `DELETE /api/terminals/:id` → `204`, or, when it was the session's last terminal and the clone has uncommitted changes, `200 { sessionId, ask: { changes: string[] } }`; `POST /api/sessions/:id/close` `{ action: "push" | "keep" | "discard" }` (`push` commits allowed files and pushes to the session branch, `keep` keeps the session live with no terminal, `discard` drops the changes; on a `save-failed` session `push` retries). **Read `routes/sessions.ts` and `src/server/sessions/sessions.ts` first and use the exact response shapes you find there** (field names of a session in `GET /api/sessions`, the close response, which may carry `skipped: string[]` and `error`). Session record (server): `{ id, repo: RepoRef, workspaceId, branch, state: "starting" | "live" | "asking" | "ending" | "save-failed", startedAt, error? }`, `RepoRef = { forge: "github" | "gitlab"; owner: string; name: string; baseUrl?: string }` (`src/server/host/types.ts`).
- `src/server/host/local.ts` `LocalWorkspaceHost.prepare` clones a missing repository into `<GM_WORKSPACES_DIR>/<forge>/<owner>/<name>` (workspace id `<forge>~<owner…>~<name>`, the same ids as today) and checks out the branch.
- Every route reads state through `const us = await ctx.store.forUser(req.user)` (`us.get()`, `us.update(fn)`); `req.user: User` (`src/server/identity.ts`). New server code in this task must do the same, never `ctx.store.get()`.
- `GET /api/auth/me` returns the signed-in user (accounts task); read `src/server/auth.ts` for the exact shape (expected `{ user: { id, name } , ... }`).

If `GET /api/sessions` does not return the cap, add it there: `limit: ctx.config.maxSessions ?? null` (the config field the sessions task added for `GM_MAX_SESSIONS`; grep `config.ts` for its name). The sidebar needs it for "2 of 3 repositories open".

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/App.tsx` (lines 7–15 imports, line 75 `<Route path="/workspaces" element={<Workspaces />} />`) — the route to replace with a redirect to `/terminals`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/Shell.tsx` (lines 15–24 `useNavCounts`, line 28 `CHORD`, line 176 the Workspaces `NavItem`) — nav, badge and `g w` chord to remove.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/CommandPalette.tsx` (line 12 `PaletteItem.group`, line 39, lines 52, 56–58, 79–93) — the Workspaces page entry, "Clone repository", and the workspace entries/actions to replace by a **New terminal** action and a **Sessions** group.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/overview.tsx` (lines 10–39 the `Overview` shape and `EMPTY`, lines 64–118 the poll, line 70 `/api/workspaces`, lines 105–106) — poll `/api/sessions` instead.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Terminals.tsx` — the whole page; key places: lines 204–242 (`createOrThrow`, `create`, `destroy`), 261–301 (`?workspace=` and `?project=` params), 404 (`pathOf` uses `overview.workspacesRoot`), 453–479 (sidebar props), 495–503 (empty state text mentions the workspaces root), 587–613 (`<NewTerminalDialog …>`), 704–838 (the old `NewTerminalDialog` with the workspace `<select>` at 775–810), 841–846 (`NewTerminalBody`, `URL_AGENTS`, `PROJECT_OPTION`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/TerminalSidebar.tsx` (lines 8–57 `workspacePath`, `groupTerminals`; 87–212 the component; 215–217 `shownOrder`) — regroup by session.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Terminals.test.tsx` (lines 1–168: the `serve()` fetch mock, `mount()`, `calls()`; lines 406–431 the dialog tests) — the test pattern to extend.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/Shell.test.tsx` (lines 28–48 fetch stub with `/api/workspaces`; 127–147 nav links; 172–200 palette and `g w` tests), `src/web/App.test.tsx` (line 28), `src/web/overview.test.tsx` (lines 18, 30–31, 73), `src/web/Settings.test.tsx` (line 40), `src/web/agentRequests.test.tsx` (line 40), `src/web/pages/Runs.test.tsx` (line 51) — tests that mock `/api/workspaces` or list the Workspaces nav item; update them.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Workspaces.tsx`, `Workspaces.css`, `Workspaces.test.tsx`, `CloneDrawer.tsx` — delete. `styles.css` line 77 has a `/* Workspaces */` block: delete the rules only `Workspaces.tsx`/`CloneDrawer.tsx` used (grep each class name before removing).

- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.tsx` (lines 173–198 the page) — add the Repositories section; line 27–28 `disconnectBody` mentions "Existing workspaces stay" (reword: "Existing clones stay").
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Runs.tsx` (lines 294–340: `useOverview().workspaces` for the filter and `wsById`; line 553 `StartRunDrawer workspaces={workspaces}`), `src/web/agentRequests.tsx` (line 88) and `src/web/pages/Projects.tsx` (lines 33, 99–106: empty state links to `/workspaces`) — consumers of `overview.workspaces`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts` (lines 71–88 `TerminalInfo`, 90–113 `ProjectEntry`/`WorkspaceEntry`, 115+ `CloneJob`) — add the session types here; delete `CloneJob` once nothing uses it.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/useAgents.ts`, `src/web/useProjects.ts` — agents and projects for the dialog.

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/sandbox.ts` (lines 103–170: `view(id)`, `GET/PUT /api/workspaces/:id/settings`) and `routes/runs.ts` (lines 230–234 `GET /api/workspaces/:id/run-defaults`) — data for Settings → Repositories.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/forges.ts` (lines 140–212 `githubClient`/`gitlabClient`; find the `ForgeClient` interface above them) and `apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-forge.mjs` (lines 75–160 repos and `handleGithub`, 180–235 `handleGitlab`) — add branch listing.
- `apps/graph-manager/README.md` lines 6, 21–22-ish quick start, 98–110 "First steps", 137, 203, 257–266 "The app", 279 "Agents and tools" ("asks for the workspace"), 310–322 "Keyboard" (`g w` row and the `Ctrl K` row), 381 "Limitations"; root `README.md` lines 21–22 and 37 (clone into a workspace).
- `TESTING.md` lines 126–149 (nav description lists Workspaces), 204–237 ("Workspaces" and "Terminals" sections), 272+ ("graph-manager UI checklist (agent-browser)").
- `apps/graph-manager/scripts/ui-smoke.sh` lines 100–125 (clones `octo/hello` via `/workspaces?clone=1`).

## Patterns to follow

**Fetching and errors (web):** `api<T>(path, init)` and `post<T>(path, body, method = "POST")` from `src/web/api.ts`; errors are `ApiError` with `.status` and `.error` (the server's `error` string). Show a server error verbatim, as the old dialog does:
```tsx
// Terminals.tsx:770
.catch((err: unknown) => setError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.error : err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)))
```
So the 409 limit message appears in the dialog exactly as the server sends it.

**Dialogs:** reuse the existing dialog markup and focus trap (`Terminals.tsx` 746–837: `div.dialog-overlay` → `form.dialog` with `role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label=…`, `useFocusTrap(ref, open, onCancel)`, `data-autofocus` on the first field, `.field`, `.field-label`, `.field-hint`, `.field-error role="alert"`, `.dialog-actions`). For confirmations use `ConfirmDialog` from `src/web/ui/Dialog` (as at `Terminals.tsx` 614–627, props `open title body cancelLabel confirmLabel tone onCancel onConfirm busy`).

**Overview poll:** keep the shape of `overview.tsx` 64–118: `Promise.allSettled([...])`, keep the last good value of each source when its request fails.

**Server route (Fastify) + per-user store + zod:**
```ts
app.get<{ Querystring: { forge?: string; fullPath?: string } }>("/api/repos/branches", async (req, reply) => {
  const q = branchesQuery.parse(req.query);           // z.object({ forge: z.enum(["github","gitlab"]), fullPath: z.string().trim().min(1) })
  const us = await ctx.store.forUser(req.user);
  ...
});
```
A `ZodError` becomes 400 `{ error: "<path>: <message>" }` and a `ForgeError` 4xx becomes 400 in `app.ts`'s error handler, so do not catch them.

**Web tests:** jsdom + Testing Library + a `fetch` stub, as `Terminals.test.tsx` 81–131 (`serve()` returns per-URL JSON; `calls(fetchMock, "POST", url)` asserts requests). Add `/api/sessions`, `/api/repos`, `/api/repos/branches`, `/api/sessions/:id/terminals`, `/api/sessions/:id/close` to that mock.

**Server tests:** `appWithLogin()` from `src/server/test-helpers.ts` and `app.inject({ method, url, headers: { cookie } })`, as `routes/workspaces.test.ts` and `routes/forges.test.ts`. The fake forge (`scripts/fake-forge.mjs`, `startFakeForge()`, tokens `gh-good` / `gl-good`, starts with GitHub `octo/hello` and GitLab `grp/sub/proj`) is how forge calls are tested; see `routes/forges.test.ts` for wiring it.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: add
  ```ts
  export interface RepoRef { forge: "github" | "gitlab"; owner: string; name: string; baseUrl?: string }
  export type SessionState = "starting" | "live" | "asking" | "ending" | "save-failed";
  /** One entry of `GET /api/sessions` (src/server/routes/sessions.ts). */
  export interface SessionInfo { id: string; repo: RepoRef; projectId?: string; workspaceId: string; branch: string; state: SessionState; startedAt: string; error?: string; terminals: string[] }
  /** One entry of `GET /api/repos`. */
  export interface ForgeRepoEntry { forge: "github" | "gitlab"; owner: string; name: string; fullPath: string; defaultBranch?: string; private?: boolean }
  ```
  Match the field names to what `routes/sessions.ts` really returns (e.g. if it returns `terminalIds`, use that); keep these names in the web code and adapt in one place (`overview.tsx`) if they differ.
- Add `repoPath(r: RepoRef) => `${r.owner}/${r.name}`` in `src/web/runs.ts` or a new `src/web/sessions.ts` (see below).
- Remove `CloneJob` once `CloneDrawer.tsx` is deleted.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck`

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/sessions.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** small pure helpers (unit-tested in `sessions.test.ts`):
  - `repoPath(repo: RepoRef): string` → `octo/hello`.
  - `sessionLabel(s: SessionInfo, projects: { id: string; name: string }[]): string` → the project's name for a project session (`projectId` set), else `repoPath(s.repo)`.
  - `defaultBranchName(userId: string, now: Date, rand: () => number = Math.random): string` → `gm/<userId>-<yyyymmdd>-<4 chars of [a-z0-9]>` (the spec's default, e.g. `gm/admin-20261113-k3x9`). Use the local date.
  - `stateLabel(state: SessionState): "starting" | "live" | "saving" | "asking" | "save-failed"` (`ending` shows as `saving`).
  - `countLine(open: number, limit: number | null): string | undefined` → `"2 of 3 repositories open"` when a limit is set, `undefined` otherwise.
  - `workspacesFromSessions(sessions: SessionInfo[]): WorkspaceEntry[]` → one `WorkspaceEntry` per session (`id: workspaceId`, `forge: repo.forge` or `"project"` for a project session, `fullPath: repoPath(repo)`, `path: ""`, `branch`, `dirty: false`, `remoteUrl: ""`) so the Runs filter, `StartRunDrawer` and `agentRequests.tsx` keep working off `overview.workspaces`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web/sessions`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/overview.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT**: replace the `/api/workspaces` request (line 70) by `api<{ sessions: SessionInfo[]; limit?: number | null }>("/api/sessions")`. `Overview` gains `sessions: SessionInfo[]` and `sessionLimit: number | null`; `workspaces` stays but is `workspacesFromSessions(sessions)`; remove `workspacesRoot` (and its last use in `Terminals.tsx` 404/499 and `Workspaces.tsx`, which is deleted). Update the comment at 48–51 ("Polls runs, terminals, sessions, forges and agent requests").
- **GOTCHA**: keep the last good `sessions` when the request fails, like the other sources.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web/overview` (update `overview.test.tsx` lines 18, 30–31, 73 to `/api/sessions`).

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/App.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT**: remove the `Workspaces` import (line 14); line 75 becomes `<Route path="/workspaces" element={<Navigate to="/terminals" replace />} />`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web/App` (update `App.test.tsx` line 28: the nav is `["Runs", "Terminals", "Projects", "Reviewers", "Settings"]`; add a test that `/workspaces` lands on `/terminals`).

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/Shell.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT**: delete the Workspaces `NavItem` (line 176); drop `workspaces` from `useNavCounts`; `CHORD` (line 28) becomes `{ r: "/runs", t: "/terminals", p: "/projects", v: "/reviewers", s: "/settings" }` so `g w` does nothing.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web/Shell` — update `Shell.test.tsx`: the stub serves `/api/sessions` (`{ sessions: [...], limit: null }`) instead of `/api/workspaces`; links lists without Workspaces; remove the `links[2]` workspace badge assertion; the `g w` test asserts the location does NOT change after `g` `w` (and `g s` still goes to `/settings`).

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/CommandPalette.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `PaletteItem.group` becomes `"Pages" | "Actions" | "Runs" | "Terminals" | "Sessions"`. Remove `p:workspaces` (line 52) and `a:clone` (line 57). Add `{ id: "a:new-terminal", group: "Actions", icon: "terminal", label: "New terminal", secondary: "action", to: "/terminals?new=1" }`. Replace the loop at 81–91 with one item per session: `{ id: `s:${s.id}`, group: "Sessions", icon: "folder", label: sessionLabel(s, []), secondary: `${s.branch} ${stateLabel(s.state)}`, to: `/terminals?session=${encodeURIComponent(s.id)}` }`. Placeholder text (line 137): `Jump to a run, terminal or session…`. Show the secondary text for the Sessions group like the other non-page groups (line 167 already does).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web/Shell` — replace the "offers pages and workspace actions" test: typing `new terminal` + Enter goes to `/terminals?new=1`; typing the session's repo `o/r` + Enter goes to `/terminals?session=<id>`; typing `clone` or `workspaces` shows "No matches".

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/TerminalSidebar.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `groupTerminals(terminals, sessions, projects)` returns one section per session (in `startedAt` order), key `session:<id>`, label `sessionLabel`, plus `branch`, `state`, `sessionId`, `error`; a terminal belongs to the session whose `terminals` list holds its id (fall back to matching `workspaceId`, or `projectId` → `project~<id>`). Terminals that belong to no session go to a last section `Other terminals` (key `other`). A session with no terminal (Keep open, `ending`, `save-failed`) still gets a section with no items. `shownOrder` follows the same order.
  - Section head: label, the branch in mono (`data-testid="session-branch-<id>"`), the state as a badge (`data-testid="session-state-<id>"`, text from `stateLabel`), and a **+** button (`aria-label="New terminal in <label>"`, `data-testid="session-new-<id>"`) that calls `onNewInSession(sessionId)`.
  - A `save-failed` section shows `error` in a `.field-error role="alert"` (`data-testid="session-error-<id>"`) with **Retry** (`data-testid="session-retry-<id>"`) and **Discard** (`data-testid="session-discard-<id>"`) buttons calling `onRetry(id)` / `onDiscard(id)`.
  - Head of the sidebar: `Terminals <count>` stays; under it `countLine(sessions.length, limit)` when defined (`data-testid="session-count"`, e.g. "2 of 3 repositories open").
  - Rename the **Plain terminal** button to **New terminal** (keep `data-testid="new-terminal"`, title `New terminal (Ctrl Space, n)`); the agent buttons stay and open the dialog with that agent preselected.
  - Props: replace `workspaces: WorkspaceEntry[]` by `sessions: SessionInfo[]`, `limit: number | null`, and add `onNewInSession(id)`, `onRetry(id)`, `onDiscard(id)`. Remove `workspacePath` (or keep it only if `Terminals.tsx`/`RunPane` still need a label for a run's workspace; then compute it from sessions).
- **GOTCHA**: `liveRunsIn(runs, workspaceId)` still keys run chips by `workspaceId` — sessions carry `workspaceId`, keep using it.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Terminals.tsx` — the New terminal dialog

- **IMPLEMENT**: replace `NewTerminalDialog` (704–838) by a new component in `src/web/pages/NewTerminalDialog.tsx` (export it; Terminals renders it). Props: `{ open; sessions: SessionInfo[]; projects: ProjectEntry[]; agents: AgentInfo[]; initial?: { sessionId?: string; repo?: RepoRef; projectId?: string; agent?: AgentId }; userId?: string; onCancel(); onOpened(r: { sessionId: string; terminalId: string; branch: string }): void }`. It posts itself (no `onCreate` body) and shows the server's error in `data-testid="new-terminal-error"`, staying open.
  - **Repository** field: a search input (`data-testid="new-terminal-search"`, `data-autofocus`, `aria-label="Repository"`, placeholder `Search repositories`). Below it a listbox (`role="listbox"`, `data-testid="new-terminal-results"`) of options, in this order: live sessions first (each with a `live` badge, `data-testid="new-terminal-live-<sessionId>"`, filtered by the query), then projects from `/api/projects` (with the projects icon, `data-testid="new-terminal-project-<id>"`; opening them is the projects task's job — keep listing them and, until `POST /api/sessions` accepts `projectId`, post `{ projectId, branch, agent }` there anyway: the server answers an error that the dialog shows), then repositories from `GET /api/repos?q=<query>` (debounced 200 ms, `data-testid="new-terminal-repo-<forge>-<owner>/<name>"`; a repository that already has a live session is shown only once, as the live entry). Arrow keys move, Enter picks. "No repositories found. Connect GitHub or GitLab in Settings." when the list is empty and no forge is connected (`useOverview().forges`).
  - **Branch** row (`data-testid="new-terminal-branch"`): for a live session it shows the session branch read-only with the hint "The branch is fixed while the session is live." For a repository: a two-way `Segmented` (`src/web/ui/Segmented`) **New branch** / **Existing branch**. New branch: an input prefilled with `defaultBranchName(userId, new Date())` (editable; `data-testid="new-terminal-branch-name"`); if `userId` is unknown or the input is emptied, send `{ new: undefined }` (omit the name; the server picks the default). Existing branch: a `<select>` (`data-testid="new-terminal-branch-existing"`) filled from `GET /api/repos/branches?forge=<forge>&fullPath=<owner/name>` (the default branch first; a loading option while it loads; the error text in the hint if it fails).
  - **Agent** row: a `<select>` (`data-testid="new-terminal-agent"`) with `Shell` (value "") and every installed agent from `useAgents()`; preselected from `initial.agent`. Keep the Qwen Code hint (`Terminals.tsx` 807–809) when `agent.connect === "project-config"`.
  - **Title** stays optional as today (`data-testid="new-terminal-title"`); if the server's create route does not accept `title`, rename the terminal after creation with `PATCH /api/terminals/:id { title }` as the tab rename does (`Terminals.tsx` 520–533).
  - Submit (`data-testid="new-terminal-create"`, label **Open**; spinner and "Opening…" while busy, "Connecting tools…" while an agent connects): live session → `POST /api/sessions/:id/terminals { agent? }`; repository → `POST /api/sessions { repo, branch: { new?: string } | { existing: string }, agent?, cols, rows }` (cols/rows as today's terminal create does, if it sends them); project → `POST /api/sessions { projectId, branch, agent? }`. On 201 call `onOpened`.
- In `Terminals.tsx`: `onOpened` adds a placeholder `TerminalInfo` (`{ id: terminalId, title: <label>, cwd: "", workspaceId, status: "idle", createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }`) to `created`, opens it in a pane (`openItem(s, termItem(id))`), closes the dialog and calls `overview.refresh()`. `createOrThrow`/`create` that posted `/api/terminals` go away (the session routes create terminals now).
  - `?new=1` opens the dialog once (StrictMode-safe with a ref, as `?workspace=` is handled at 261–278) and is removed from the URL.
  - `?session=<id>` opens that session's terminals (the first one in the focused pane, the rest as tabs) and is replaced by `?focus=<first terminal id>`; a session with no terminal opens the dialog on it.
  - `?workspace=<id>` (the Runs page's "Open terminal" link uses it: `Runs.test.tsx` 186) opens a new terminal in the live session with that `workspaceId` via `POST /api/sessions/:id/terminals`, or, when none is live, opens the dialog with that repository preselected (parse `<forge>~<owner…>~<name>` into a `RepoRef`).
  - `?project=<id>[&agent=]` opens the dialog with that project (and agent) preselected (the projects task finishes project sessions).
  - The empty state text (line 499): "No terminals open. Open a repository to start a session." with the **New terminal** button.
  - `Ctrl Space n` and the sidebar's **New terminal** open the dialog; an agent button opens it with that agent preselected; a section's **+** opens it on that session.
  - The user id: read `GET /api/auth/me` once (`user.id`), ignore failures.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Terminals.tsx` — closing and the uncommitted-changes dialog

- **IMPLEMENT**: `destroy(t)` (230–242) reads the DELETE answer: on `200 { sessionId, ask: { changes } }` open `CloseSessionDialog` (new file `src/web/pages/CloseSessionDialog.tsx`):
  - title `"<label> has uncommitted changes."` (e.g. `acme/api has uncommitted changes.`), the changed files as a mono list (first 20, then "and N more"), buttons **Push to branch** (`data-testid="close-push"`, primary), **Keep open** (`data-testid="close-keep"`), **Discard** (`data-testid="close-discard"`, danger).
  - Push → `POST /api/sessions/:id/close { action: "push" }`; if the answer lists `skipped` files, show a toast `Pushed to <branch>. Not committed: .env, key.pem` (`useToast().show({ tone: "ok", text })`); if it answers an error or the session turns `save-failed`, show the error in the dialog.
  - Keep open → `{ action: "keep" }`, closes the dialog (the session stays in the sidebar with no terminals, and still counts).
  - Discard → a `ConfirmDialog` "Discard all uncommitted changes in <label>?" (confirm label **Discard**, tone danger), then `{ action: "discard" }`.
  - Escape or clicking outside = Keep open is NOT assumed: the dialog has no cancel; Esc does nothing but focus stays trapped (the session is `asking` until the user picks).
  - A session that shows `asking` in the overview while no dialog is open (e.g. after a reload) gets the same dialog from its sidebar section (an **Uncommitted changes…** button, `data-testid="session-ask-<id>"`), which first reads the file list — use the `changes` the server keeps on the session if `GET /api/sessions` returns them, otherwise show the dialog without the list.
- `onRetry(id)` → `POST /api/sessions/:id/close { action: "push" }`; `onDiscard(id)` → the same confirm, then `{ action: "discard" }`. Refresh the overview after each.
